about: Speed budgets CI holds the app to (docs/android-standards.md, Speed). speed-budget.py fails
when a Macrobenchmark metric is above tolerance x its budget; check-apk.sh fails when the
release APK is above apk.tolerance x apk.bytes.
The metric budgets are what CI's emulator measured for 8.0 on main (run 40034069262,
2026-10-23: swiftshader, 2 cores; far slower than a phone, so they are not the 500 ms device
target). The APK budget is 9.0's sideload release APK (run 40087717696, 2026-10-24).
Lower a budget when the app gets faster; raise one only with a reason in the commit.
